boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-cost, under-21-safe campus activities with current access or admission evidence.

cards.title: Reset at Gentle Yoga
cards.subtitle: O’Pake Fitness and Recreation Center, Hawk Hill
cards.notes: Register in advance, then bring a friend for a slower yoga session with flexibility work, breathing and meditation time.
cards.short_summary: A low-impact group class for stretching and settling in.
cards.evidence_claim: SJU lists Gentle Yoga among its group fitness classes; all group fitness classes are free and open to students, faculty and staff.
cards.source_title: Group Fitness | Campus Recreation | Saint Joseph's University
cards.access_notes: Free for SJU students, faculty and staff; advance registration is required. Hawk Hill classes meet in the O’Pake group exercise room.

cards.title: Move Together at Kickboxing
cards.subtitle: O’Pake Fitness and Recreation Center, Hawk Hill
cards.notes: Reserve a spot ahead of time and join the class for cardio drills combining jabs, kicks and martial-arts-inspired movement.
cards.short_summary: A structured cardio class with athletic drills and martial arts movement.
cards.evidence_claim: SJU lists Kickboxing as a group fitness class and states that group fitness classes are free and open to students, faculty and staff.
cards.source_title: Group Fitness | Campus Recreation | Saint Joseph's University
cards.access_notes: Free for SJU students, faculty and staff; advance registration is required. Hawk Hill classes meet in the O’Pake group exercise room.

cards.evidence_claim: SJU lists Pilates as a group fitness class and states that group fitness classes are free and open to students, faculty and staff.
cards.source_title: Group Fitness | Campus Recreation | Saint Joseph's University

cards.short_summary: Trainer-led sessions designed for small groups and varied fitness levels.
cards.evidence_claim: SJU lists Small Group Training Fitness Classes and states that group fitness classes are free and open to students, faculty and staff.

cards.title: Practice Yoga in University City
cards.subtitle: Glasser 307, University City campus
cards.notes: Register ahead and use the class to explore alignment, movement and breath, with options suited to beginners and continuing students.
cards.short_summary: A University City yoga class focused on balance, stability and breath.
cards.evidence_claim: SJU lists Yoga at University City and states that group fitness classes are free and open to students, faculty and staff.

cards.entity_name: Frances M. Maguire Art Museum Self-Guided Tour
cards.title: Take a Self-Guided Museum Tour
cards.subtitle: Frances M. Maguire Art Museum, 50 Lapsley Lane
cards.notes: Visit during public hours and wander the galleries at your own pace; use the seating, children’s library and sensory activities if useful.
cards.short_summary: Free gallery time with self-guided access to the Maguire Art Museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Frances M. Maguire Art Museum states that admission is free for all visitors and invites visitors to enjoy a self-guided tour.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Frances M. Maguire Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Admission is free for all visitors. Current summer public hours are Wednesday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; SJU students and employees have seven-day access.

cards.title: See the University Galleries
cards.subtitle: Merion Hall Gallery and Boland Hall Gallery
cards.notes: Plan a gallery stop around current hours, then look for rotating student work in Boland Hall or professional artist exhibits in Merion Hall.
cards.short_summary: Free public galleries presenting student and professional visual-art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: SJU states that its University Galleries are free and open to the public, identifying Merion Hall Gallery and Boland Hall Gallery as locations.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public. The page lists Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–7 p.m., Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m., and Merion Hall Saturday 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; confirm break hours by email.

cards.title: Attend the Asian Film Series
cards.subtitle: Nealis Program in Asian Studies, Hawk Hill
cards.notes: Check the semester’s film listing, then attend a screening and stay for the informal discussion that follows each selected film.
cards.short_summary: Semester film screenings about Asia followed by informal discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: SJU says its Asian Film Series hosts films each semester followed by informal discussion, and that all events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Asian Film Series | Saint Joseph's University
cards.access_notes: All events are free and open to the public. Check the program page for the current semester’s screening details before going.
